name: vk-mcp-server
description: Read and post to VK (VKontakte) — walls, communities, users, photos and stats.
long_description:
Connects an AI assistant to the VK (VKontakte) social network. Read walls, search users and communities, inspect members and reactions, pull community statistics, and — when you ask it to — publish posts, comments and photos.

Read-only tools are marked as such, so a client can run lookups freely while still asking before anything is posted, edited or deleted.

Needs a VK access token, which you can create from your VK account in about a minute.

vk_access_token.title: VK access token
vk_access_token.description: Create one at https://oauth.vk.com/authorize?client_id=6121396&scope=wall,friends,groups,photos,stats,offline&response_type=token — after authorising, copy the access_token value out of the address bar.

vk_timeout_ms.title: Request timeout (ms)
vk_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for VK before giving up on a request.
